name: standup
description: /standup: a pane of the PRs you opened, merged and reviewed, the commits you made and the Claude Code sessions you worked in on a work day, with a button to draft the update

repos.title: Local repos
repos.description: Comma-separated local repo paths (absolute, ~/..., or relative to your home folder) to read commits from, including unpushed branches. GitHub search covers pushed commits either way.

utcOffset.title: UTC offset
utcOffset.description: Your time zone as an offset from UTC, like +03:00 or -05:00. Decides where a day starts and ends.

workDays.title: Work days
workDays.description: Comma-separated work days, like Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri or Sun,Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu. /standup defaults to the previous one.

draftCommand.title: Draft command
draftCommand.description: Slash command the Draft button runs with the day as its argument, like work. Leave empty to send Claude a prompt with the day's activity instead.
